summary: The Toronto Police Service and City of Toronto identified an immediate opportunity to undertake a gun buyback to reduce the presence of unwanted firearms in Toronto. Authority to provide funding to the Toronto Police Service to administer the initiative is required.
decided: City Council on May 14 and 15, 2019, adopted the following: 1. City Council authorize a $750,000 gross and net increase to the Toronto Police Service Council-Approved 2019 Operating Budget, funded from the 2019 non-program expenditure budget, to provide one-time funding of up to the same amount for a gun buyback initiative.

text: The Toronto Police Service and City of Toronto identified an immediate opportunity to undertake a gun buyback to reduce the presence of unwanted firearms in Toronto. Authority to provide funding to the Toronto Police Service to administer the initiative is required.

City Council on May 14 and 15, 2019, adopted the following: 1. City Council authorize a $750,000 gross and net increase to the Toronto Police Service Council-Approved 2019 Operating Budget, funded from the 2019 non-program expenditure budget, to provide one-time funding of up to the same amount for a gun buyback initiative.
